from playwright.sync_api import Page

def test_ai_recorded(page: Page):
    page.goto('https://test.waiqin.yios.cn/warehouse/warehouse')
    page.get_by_placeholder('请输入仓库编码').fill('WH001')
    page.get_by_role('button', name='重置').click()
    page.get_by_placeholder('请选择字段').select_option('仓库编码')
    page.get_by_role('button', name='添加条件').click()
    page.get_by_role('button', name='查询').click()
